title: Roblox Rephrased Message Spammer
features: Makes you send 10 messages that'll get rephrased
script:

-- 30 second cooldown

-- Pad to ~1000 entries by repeating the list.
local original = table.clone(words)
while #words < 1000 do
	for _, w in ipairs(original) do
		table.insert(words, w)
		if #words >= 1000 then
			break
		end
	end
end

local function randomMessage()
	return string.format(
		"%s %s fkng %s %s %s %s",
		words[math.random(#words)],
		words[math.random(#words)],
		words[math.random(#words)],
		words[math.random(#words)],
		words[math.random(#words)],
		words[math.random(#words)]
	)
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.R then return end
	if sending then return end

	local now = tick()
	if now - lastUse < COOLDOWN then
		return
	end

	lastUse = now
	sending = true

	local channel = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")

	if channel then
		for i = 1, 10 do
			channel:SendAsync(randomMessage())
			if i < 10 then
				task.wait(0.1)
			end
		end
	end

	sending = false
end)
